mapper.insert: INSERT INTO species ( species_id, japanese_name, common_name, english_name, total_length, body_weight, lifespan, create_user, create_at, update_user, update_at ) VALUES ( #{speciesId}, #{japaneseName}, #{commonName}, #{englishName}, #{totalLength}, #{bodyWeight}, #{lifespan}, #{createUser}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{updateUser}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
mapper.update: UPDATE species SET species_id = #{species.speciesId}, japanese_name = #{species.japaneseName}, common_name = #{species.commonName}, english_name = #{species.englishName}, total_length = #{species.totalLength}, body_weight = #{species.bodyWeight}, lifespan = #{species.lifespan}, update_user = #{species.updateUser}, update_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE species_id = #{speciesId}
